title: Create Stunning $10,000 3D Websites with Claude Fable 5! 🚀 Easy Step-by-Step Guide Inside
description:
Discover how Claude Fable 5 is revolutionizing website creation by building stunning, cinematic 3D scrolling sites that rival top-tier designs like Apple’s homepage. These aren’t just simple AI landing pages — these are premium, visually engaging websites that people are charging $10,000 for! In this video, I’ll walk you through the exact steps to unleash Claude Fable 5’s full potential. First, switch Claude Code to Fable 5 and set the reasoning level to extra or max. Then connect to the Higgsfield MCP to automatically generate all images and videos for your site. Next, provide a single prompt describing your ideal website, whether it’s for a luxury watch brand, personal portfolio, or a unique fictional business. Finally, use CDANCE 2.0 to generate the entire site from scratch — all with just one prompt! Want the full setup guide and prompt pack? Comment “Fable” below, and I’ll send it your way!
